title: Saudi Arabia Says It Intercepted 10 Houthi Ballistic Missiles; Houthis Threaten Riyadh Airport
detail: Le Monde reports the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted ten ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis toward Riyadh and southern Saudi Arabia. The Houthis reportedly threatened Riyadh airport, which is trying to reopen. Single-source report relaying a coalition claim; damage and Houthi account not yet independently confirmed.

media.caption: Le Monde report on interception of ten Houthi missiles

title: Saudi Arabia Reopens Riyadh Airport After Weeks of Houthi Attacks
detail: The New York Times reports Saudi Arabia reopened Riyadh's airport after weeks of Houthi attacks. Only the headline was available at time of writing; details of the closure and resumed operations are not yet verified.

media.caption: NYT report on Riyadh airport reopening

title: Houthi Missile Debris Injures Two People in Saudi Arabia
detail: A report aggregated via Google News says debris from a Houthi missile injured two people in Saudi Arabia. Single headline-level report; location and outlet details not independently confirmed.
